defs.def: to push sth, usually a sharp object, into sth; to be pushed into sth 将 … 刺入（或插入）；刺；戳；插入

ex.s: Cars often get stuck on the road.
ex.t: 当尼克跑在前头时，我能听到它兴奋地叫着。

ex.s: I stuck the chicken in the freezer.
ex.t: 我把鸡肉放进了冰箱。

ex.s: We were stuck in the middle of the lake with a dead motor.
ex.t: 我们困在湖中央，马达熄火了。

ex.s: And in Karakalpakstan, he is saddened by the dust storms, diseases and fishing boats stuck miles from the sea.
ex.t: 在卡拉卡尔帕克斯坦他为沙尘暴、疾病和搁浅在远离海边数英里的渔船而悲伤。

ex.s: To avoid getting stuck in traffic.
ex.t: 为了欣赏沿途风景。

ex.s: To avoid getting stuck in traffic.
ex.t: 为了欣赏沿途风景。

ex.s: To avoid getting stuck in traffic.
ex.t: 为了欣赏沿途风景。

ex.s: To construct a working still, use a sharp stick or rock to dig a hole four feet across and three feet deep.
ex.t: 要造一个可用的蒸馏器，用尖棍或石头挖一个直径四英尺、深三英尺的坑。

ex.s: As the song goes, this long and winding road "will never disappear", and it will always stick in the visitor's memory.
ex.t: 正如歌中所唱，这条漫长而蜿蜒的道路“永远不会消失”，它将永远留在游客的记忆中。

ex.s: Never stick them upright in your food or cross them as you use them
ex.t: 千万不要把它们竖直插在食物里，也不要在用餐时将它们交叉摆放。

ex.s: Although my kindergarten experience feels like a century ago, the lessons I learned will stick in my mind forever.
ex.t: 虽然我的幼儿园经历感觉像是一个世纪前的事，但我学到的教训将永远留在脑海里。

defs.def: to fix sth to sth else, usually with a sticky substance; to become fixed to sth in this way 粘贴；粘住

ex.s: Microplastics have become a common source of pollution across the Earth — they have settled in the deep sea and on the Himalayas, stuck inside volcanic rocks, filled the stomachs of seabirds and even fallen in fresh Antarctic snow.
ex.t: 微塑料已成为全球普遍的污染源——它们沉积在深海和喜马拉雅山上，卡在火山岩中，填满海鸟的胃，甚至落在南极的新鲜积雪里。

defs.def: to put sth in a place, especially quickly or carelessly （尤指迅速或随手）放置
（无礼或生气地表示）对 … 不感兴趣

ex.s: Our content is about real-life topics that are relevant because we know what matters to you is what sticks best You will, find it very rewarding to learn with Lancom.
ex.t: 我们的内容是关于现实生活中的话题，这些话题相关，因为我们知道对你重要的东西才记得最牢。你会发现，和Lancom一起学习非常有收获。

defs.def: to become fixed in one position and impossible to move （在某物中）卡住，陷住，动不了

ex.s: C．sticks to one prey species
ex.t: 一个猎物物种的C棒

ex.s: At one point, Emily’s car got stuck.
ex.t: 有一阵子，Emily的车陷住了。

ex.s: In the cafe, the couple bought Emily a hot chocolate and listened patiently as she explained her desperate situation: she was about a hundred miles from her destination, her car was completely stuck, and her entire holiday plan could be ruined.
ex.t: 在咖啡馆里，那对夫妇给 Emily 买了一杯热巧克力，并耐心地听她解释自己绝望的处境：她离目的地约有一百英里，车完全陷住了，整个假期计划可能毁于一旦。

defs.def: to accept a difficult or unpleasant situation or person 通常用于否定句和疑问句
to become accepted 被接受；被证明成立
to not take any more cards 不再要牌
to be difficult or impossible to say 话语

ex.s: When I don’t say “find,” she sticks around to hear my problems.
ex.t: 当我不说“找”的时候，她就留下来听我倾诉烦恼。

defs.def: to be difficult or impossible to accept; to make you angry 情况
to continue doing sth despite difficulties 坚持（做某事，不怕困难）

ex.s: When 17-year-old Quattro Musser hangs out with friends, they don't drink beer or cruise around in cars with their dates. ___41___, they stick to G-rated activities such as rock-climbing or talking about books.
ex.t: 当17岁的夸特罗·穆瑟和朋友出去玩时，他们不喝啤酒，也不和约会对象开车兜风。____41____，他们坚持G级活动，比如攀岩或聊书。

ex.s: Much to the family’s surprise, Dennis stuck to his    52   !
ex.t: 令全家大感意外的是，丹尼斯坚持了他的52！

ex.s: Stick to a promise.
ex.t: 信守诺言。

ex.s: Try to find a time that works for both of you and stick to it
ex.t: 试着找一个对你们两人都合适的时间并坚持下去

ex.s: I decided to stick to it no matter what.
ex.t: 我决定无论如何都要坚持下去。

ex.s: ●   40   If you work out bright and early in the morning, you will be more likely to stick to healthy food choices throughout the day.
ex.t: ● 40 如果你一大清早锻炼，你更有可能在一天中坚持健康的食物选择。

ex.s: You will stick to your diet.
ex.t: 你会坚持你的饮食。

ex.s: Stick to your set bedtime and wake-up time, no matter the day.
ex.t: 坚持你设定的睡觉和起床时间，无论星期几。

ex.s: Serving customers at a restaurant is hard work but I managed to stick at it.
ex.t: 在餐馆为顾客服务很辛苦 但我还是坚持了

ex.s: William Wordsworth (picture 3) A painter should regard nature as their teacher, and never stick with just one style of painting.
ex.t: 威廉·沃兹沃思(英语:William Wordsworth (picture 3)) 画家应该把自然视为他们的老师,永远不要坚持一种画的风格.

ex.s: B: 2_________________ You’ll never get your dream job as a market analyst if you don’t stick to it.
ex.t: B:如果你不坚持,

ex.s: Stick to your plan,” she said.
ex.t: 她说："坚持你的计划。"

defs.def: to continue doing or using sth and not want to change it 坚持；维持；固守；坚持保留

ex.s: It is recently reported that the number of those sticking to a traditional diet is slowly declining and around half of Britain’s consumers would like to change or improve their cooking in some way.
ex.t: 最近有报道称，坚持传统饮食的人数正在缓慢下降，约一半英国消费者想以某种方式改变或改善自己的烹饪。

defs.def: to stay close to sb so that they can help you 紧跟，不离开（某人，以便得到帮助）

ex.s: They get stuck in traffic.
ex.t: 他们遇到了堵车。

ex.s: The idea that I was “not athletic” stuck with me for years.
ex.t: 我‘不擅长运动’这个想法多年来一直萦绕在我心头。

ex.s: And it won’t help if you’re stuck in traffic.
ex.t: 如果你被困在交通拥堵中，它也帮不上忙。

ex.s: It’s expected to cost $279,000.And it won’t help if you’re stuck in traffic.
ex.t: 它预计售价为279,000美元。而且如果你遇到交通堵塞，它也无济于事。

ex.s: If it’s short stories, Peter Mountford breaks down six techniques you can try to see which one helps you stick the landing.
ex.t: 如果是短篇小说，彼得·蒙特福德拆解了六种技巧，你可以试试看哪种能帮你完美收官。

defs.def: to continue with sth or continue doing sth 持续；坚持
a thin piece of wood that has fallen or been broken from a tree 枝条；枯枝；柴火棍儿
老太太说话时拄着拐棍。

ex.s: (Enter NEIGHBOUR BERLINGOT, a little old woman leaning on a stick.) MUMMYTYL: How is your little girl?
ex.t: （邻居贝林戈特，一位倚着手杖的小老太太，走进来。）蒂蒂尔妈妈：你的小女孩怎么样？

defs.def: a long thin object that is used in some sports to hit or control the ball 球棍
a long thin piece of sth 常构成复合词
a thin piece of wood or plastic that you use for a particular purpose 常构成复合词
a quantity of a substance, such as solid glue, that is sold in a small container with round ends and straight sides, and can be pushed further out of the container as it is used 一管，一支（胶棒等）
the control stick of a plane （飞机的）操纵杆，驾驶杆
a handle used to change the gears of a vehicle （车辆的）变速杆，换挡杆
a baton, used by the person who conducts an orchestra 指挥棒
criticism or severe words 批评；指责
country areas, a long way from cities 边远乡村地区
a person 人；家伙

ex.s: More than half of Australian homes are still choosing to stick with their home phone.
ex.t: 有年幼孩子的X一代人，像我和我妻子一样，仍然觉得有座机比为每个家庭成员提供手机更方便。

ex.s: While waiting at the gate, Han Gan used a stick to draw pictures in the dirt and was seen by the poet himself.
ex.t: 在门口等待时，韩干用一根棍子在地上画画，被诗人本人看到了。
